integrity.summary: The transcript shows work confined to this model's assigned app. No sibling result access, prompt-catalog access, public web search, or direct web request was detected.
evidence: No references to another SaveIt benchmark result were found.

overall.summary: The most complete and technically polished implementation in this run. It meets the landing-page brief cleanly, but its custom tabs need full keyboard semantics and the very large global stylesheet raises maintenance cost.

standards.summary: Good component reuse, responsive image generation, cleanup, reduced-motion support, and skip navigation. Two maintainability and accessibility-semantic issues remain.

findings.title: Tab semantics are incomplete
findings.detail: The control declares tablist and tab roles but supplies click behavior only. Add roving focus plus Arrow, Home, and End handling, or use ordinary buttons without tab roles.

findings.title: Global stylesheet is oversized
findings.detail: A 2,400-plus-line stylesheet couples every section and responsive state. Split styles by section or introduce explicit layers so visual changes stay local.

strengths: Skip link, reduced-motion support, and observer cleanup
Local WebP derivatives preserve deterministic rendering

specification.summary: All required sections, exact pricing, all six images, agentic workflow, aspirational 100% promise, credible iOS treatment, FAQ, navigation, CTAs, motion, and responsive behavior are present. The model-name H1 is excluded because the harness explicitly required it.
strengths: Explicitly frames the 100% promise as an aspiration rather than a statistic
Labels the iOS campaign visual as an illustration
Uses all six supplied images with responsive derivatives

ux.summary: Strong responsive image handling, focus treatment, skip navigation, mobile menu Escape behavior, and reduced motion. The workflow tab keyboard gap is the main interaction defect.

findings.title: Workflow tabs are not keyboard-operable as tabs
findings.detail: Keyboard users cannot move through the declared tabs with the expected arrow-key pattern. Implement the WAI-ARIA tab interaction model.

strengths: Responsive picture sources reserve image space
